method_docs.compiler/rustc_infer/src/infer/opaque_ty: Scans a foldable value for return-position local opaque types that are currently being defined, replaces each such opaque with a fresh type inference variable, and accumulates the obligations needed to relate that variable back to the opaque definition. It calls `opaque_type_origin` to filter eligible opaques and `handle_opaque_type` to create the corresponding obligations/registration.

Handles relating an opaque type to another type during inference: it ignores error types, determines which side is the opaque, checks whether the opaque is being defined in the current context, diagnoses invalid opaque-to-opaque hidden-type cases, and then equates or records the hidden type as appropriate. It calls `opaque_type_origin` when defining-use checks are required, `opaque_ty_origin_unchecked` otherwise, and `register_hidden_type` to store the inferred hidden type before using the inference relation machinery to equate types.

Builds lifetime membership constraints for an inferred opaque hidden type so every region appearing in the concrete type is restricted to the opaque type's allowed lifetime arguments or `'static`. It calls `opaque_ty_origin_unchecked` to determine how many generics belong to the opaque itself, resolves inference variables in the concrete type, and then visits the type to emit member constraints.

Returns the origin of a local opaque type only if that opaque may be defined from the current defining-use anchor, distinguishing async/fn-return opaques from type-alias opaques. It uses HIR lookup plus `may_define_opaque_type` to decide whether a type-alias opaque is in scope for definition.

Fetches the HIR-declared origin of a local opaque type without checking whether the current context is allowed to define it. It performs only local-ID conversion and item-kind inspection, and does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Visits the contents of a binder without special casing it, delegating traversal to `t.super_visit_with(self)` and then continuing.
Processes each region seen by the visitor, ignoring late-bound regions and invoking the visitor callback `self.op` for all other regions before continuing.

Traverses only types that contain free regions and skips enclosing-item lifetime parameters for closures and generators. For closures it calls `substs.as_closure().tupled_upvars_ty().visit_with(self)` and `substs.as_closure().sig_as_fn_ptr_ty().visit_with(self)`; for generators it calls `substs.as_generator().tupled_upvars_ty().visit_with(self)`, `return_ty().visit_with(self)`, `yield_ty().visit_with(self)`, and `resume_ty().visit_with(self)`; otherwise it falls back to `ty.super_visit_with(self)`.
Returns whether this `UseKind` represents a defining use, yielding true for `DefiningUse` and false for `OpaqueUse`.

Registers or updates the inferred hidden type for an opaque definition, equates it with any previously registered hidden type, and then instantiates the opaque item's explicit bounds against the hidden type while introducing inference variables for projections and substituting self-references to the same opaque. It does not call other methods from the provided Methods List.
Checks whether a named opaque type may be defined from the given local item by walking up the HIR parent chain from the item to see whether it reaches the opaque type’s defining scope.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/opaqu: Trait method declaration for inferring an opaque type's hidden definition type from an instantiated use-site hidden type; implemented by the `InferCtxt` method of the same name.

Infers the hidden definition type for an opaque type by reverse-mapping instantiated substitutions back into the opaque type's generic parameter space, rejecting tainted/error states early, folding the hidden type through `ReverseMapper::new`, and validating the defining use with `check_opaque_type_parameter_valid`. For `OpaqueTyOrigin::TyAlias`, it additionally re-checks well-formedness and bound satisfaction in a fresh inference context, registers the hidden type and obligations, and reports mismatches or fulfillment errors before returning the rebuilt opaque type.
Constructs a `ReverseMapper` initialized with the type context, opaque type id, reverse substitution map, hidden type, and diagnostic span.
Folds a generic argument with the reverse mapper while temporarily enabling missing-region fallback to the empty root region; this method calls `fold_with`.
Folds a generic argument with normal reverse-mapping behavior, without permitting missing regions; this method calls `fold_with`.
Returns the `TyCtxt` carried by the reverse mapper.

Reverse-maps regions from the instantiated hidden type back to the opaque definition, leaving late-bound/static/erased regions unchanged, translating mapped early-bound/free regions through the substitution map, and emitting diagnostics for unexpected or non-defining hidden lifetimes. This method calls `tcx` to inspect generics and obtain fallback lifetime values.

Reverse-maps types inside the hidden type, with special handling for closures and generators so parent generic arguments may map missing regions to `'empty`, remaps type parameters through the reverse substitution map, reports unmapped captured type parameters as invalid defining uses, and otherwise recursively folds substructure. This method calls `fold_kind_mapping_missing_regions_to_empty` and `fold_kind_normally` for closure/generator substs, and falls back to `super_fold_with` for other types.

Reverse-maps const generic parameters appearing in the hidden type back to the opaque type's parameter space, returning mapped const params when found and otherwise emitting an error and producing a const error value for unmapped defining-scope consts.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_middle/src/ty/relate.rs::: Required hook that returns the `TyCtxt<'tcx>` used by the relation; it does not call other covered methods.
Required hook that returns the current `ParamEnv<'tcx>` for the relation; it does not call other covered methods.
Required hook that provides a static debug tag naming the relation; it does not call other covered methods.
Required hook indicating whether the left-hand side should be treated as the expected value in diagnostics; it does not call other covered methods.
Default helper that runs a closure under a supplied `Cause` and simply invokes the closure; it does not call other covered methods.
Generic dispatcher that delegates relation of any `Relate` value to `Relate::relate`; it does not call other covered methods from this file directly.
Relates substitutions for a specific item by fetching its variances from the type context and then calling `tcx` and `relate_substs_with_variances`.
Required hook for relating two values under an explicit variance and diagnostic context; it does not call other covered methods.
Required hook that relates two `Ty<'tcx>` values; it does not call other covered methods.
Required hook that relates two regions; it does not call other covered methods.
Required hook that relates two constants; it does not call other covered methods.
Required hook that relates two binders while handling bound variables appropriately; it does not call other covered methods.
Core trait entry point each relatable type implements to structurally compare and rebuild itself under a `TypeRelation`; it does not call other covered methods.

Relates a `TypeAndMut` pair by first requiring identical mutability, then choosing covariance for shared references and invariance for mutable ones before calling `relate_with_variance` on the pointee type.
Relates two substitution lists invariantly element-by-element and rebuilds them in the current type context; it calls `tcx` and `relate_with_variance`.
Relates two substitution lists using a provided variance per parameter, computing invariant diagnostic info from the instantiated item type when needed; it calls `tcx` and `relate_with_variance`.

Relates function signatures by checking variadicity and arity, relating unsafety and ABI directly, then relating inputs contravariantly and the output normally while remapping sort and mutability errors to argument-indexed forms; it calls `tcx`, `relate`, and `relate_with_variance`.
Relates bound constness by requiring exact equality and otherwise reporting `ConstnessMismatch`; it does not call other covered methods.
Relates unsafety flags by requiring exact equality and otherwise reporting `UnsafetyMismatch`; it does not call other covered methods.
Relates ABIs by requiring exact equality and otherwise reporting `AbiMismatch`; it does not call other covered methods.
Relates projection types only when they name the same associated item, then relates their substitutions and rebuilds the projection; it calls `relate`.
Relates existential projections only when they share the same associated item, then invariantly relates both the projected term and substitutions; it calls `relate_with_variance`.
Relates trait references only when they point to the same trait definition, then relates their substitutions; it calls `relate_substs`.
Relates existential trait references only when they point to the same trait definition, then relates their substitutions; it calls `relate_substs`.
Relates two generator-witness type lists positionally after asserting equal length, rebuilding the witness from the related element types; it calls `tcx` and `relate`.

Relates impl subjects only when both are trait impls or both are inherent impls, delegating to trait-ref or type relation accordingly and treating mixed shapes as impossible; it calls `impl<'tcx> Relate<'tcx> for ty::TraitRef<'tcx>::relate` and `impl<'tcx> Relate<'tcx> for Ty<'tcx>::relate`.
For `Ty<'tcx>`, the `Relate` implementation is just a thin forwarder to the relation’s type hook; it calls `tys`.

Structural fallback for relating concrete `Ty<'tcx>` shapes: it rejects inference and bound types, propagates error types, handles primitive/param/placeholder equality, and rebuilds matching composite types such as ADTs, trait objects, generators, closures, pointers, references, arrays, and others by delegating to relation hooks with the correct variance. It calls `tcx`, `with_cause`, `relate_item_substs`, `relate_with_variance`, `relate`, and `relate_type_and_mut`.

Structural fallback for relating constants: it checks type compatibility, eagerly evaluates both sides, compares compatible const forms, recursively relates substs for matching unevaluated constants, and rebuilds the result or reports `ConstMismatch`. It calls `tag`, `tcx`, `param_env`, `check_const_value_eq`, and `relate_with_variance`.

Compares evaluated constant values for structural equality across scalars, function pointers, slices, references, and by-reference aggregates; for aggregate constants it destructures both sides and recursively relates each field constant. It calls `tcx`, `param_env`, and `consts`.

Relates two existential predicate lists by collecting, sorting, and deduplicating both sides, rejecting different list sizes with `TypeError::ExistentialMismatch` via `expected_found`. It then pairwise matches predicate kinds and recursively calls `relation.relate` for corresponding `Trait` and `Projection` entries, keeps equal `AutoTrait` entries unchanged, and finally rebuilds the list with `tcx.mk_poly_existential_predicates`.
Relates two `ty::ClosureSubsts` by calling `relate_substs` on their underlying substitution lists and returning a new `ClosureSubsts` with the related substs.
Relates two `ty::GeneratorSubsts` by calling `relate_substs` on their underlying substitution lists and returning a new `GeneratorSubsts` with the related substs.
Relates two substitution lists directly by calling `relate_substs`.
Delegates region relation to the relation context by calling `relation.regions`.
Delegates const relation to the relation context by calling `relation.consts`.
Delegates binder relation to the relation context by calling `relation.binders`.

Relates two generic arguments only when their variants match: it calls `relation.relate` for paired lifetimes, types, or consts and converts the related result back into a `GenericArg`. Mixed variants are treated as impossible and trigger `bug!`.
Relates impl polarity by requiring exact equality; on mismatch it returns `TypeError::PolarityMismatch` constructed with `expected_found`.
Relates a trait predicate field-by-field, calling `relation.relate` on `trait_ref`, `constness`, and `polarity`, then rebuilding the predicate from the related components.

Relates two terms only when both are the same variant: it calls `relation.relate` for `Ty` pairs and for `Const` pairs, converts the result back into a term, and returns `TypeError::Mismatch` for mixed variants.
Relates a projection predicate field-by-field by calling `relation.relate` on `projection_ty` and `term`, then rebuilding the predicate.
Builds an `ExpectedFound<T>` by calling `ExpectedFound::new` with the relation's `a_is_expected()` polarity and the two provided values.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::repl: Prepares MIR for NLL by computing `UniversalRegions` for the body and then replacing remaining MIR regions with fresh inference variables. Calls `UniversalRegions::new`, `renumber::renumber_mir`, and `dump_mir`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::popu: Populates Polonius move-related facts from MIR move data by recording local-to-path mappings, parent/child move-path relationships, initialization points, and argument/variable metadata. It is self-recursive via `populate_polonius_move_facts` in the recorded call list, and otherwise only uses collection/iteration helpers and MIR accessors rather than calling other methods from the provided Methods List.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::comp: Drives NLL region computation: decides whether Polonius inputs/outputs are needed, runs MIR type checking to gather region constraints and opaque type candidates, emits Polonius facts, builds and solves a `RegionInferenceContext`, and packages the final `NllOutput` including opaque type inference and any Polonius results. Calls `type_check::type_check`, `infcx.get_region_var_origins`, `polonius::emit_facts`, `RegionInferenceContext::new`, `polonius::Output::compute`, `RegionInferenceContext::solve`, and `RegionInferenceContext::infer_opaque_types`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::dump: Emits debugging dumps for inferred NLL results when MIR dumping is enabled, including region values, closure region constraints, and Graphviz views of raw and SCC region-constraint graphs. Calls `dump_enabled`, `dump_mir`, `for_each_region_constraint`, `create_dump_file`, `RegionInferenceContext::dump_graphviz_raw_constraints`, and `RegionInferenceContext::dump_graphviz_scc_constraints`.

Produces `#[rustc_regions]` diagnostic notes for a body, annotating the inferred region state, listing closure outlives requirements when present, and showing inferred opaque type values. Calls `RegionInferenceContext::annotate`, `for_each_region_constraint`, and `BorrowckDiags::buffer_non_error`.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::for_: Formats each closure outlives requirement into a human-readable message and passes it to the provided callback; for type subjects, it instantiates the type with fresh region variables first. Calls `ty::instantiate`, `ty::Region::new_var`, and the provided `with_msg` callback.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::pub: Trait method that defines the interface for converting the implementing value into a `RegionVid`; it does not call any other method in this file.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::impl: Converts a `Region<'tcx>` into its underlying `RegionVid` by matching the region as `ty::ReVar` and returning the contained vid; it does not call any other method in this file, and instead directly inspects the region variant.
Identity conversion for `RegionVid` that simply returns `self`; it does not call any other method in this file.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/nll.rs::desc: Trait-style method declaration for obtaining a static textual description; it does not call any other method in this file.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_borrowck/src/member_const: Constructs an empty `MemberConstraintSet` by default-initializing the key-to-list map, stored constraints, and shared choice-region buffer. It calls `Default::default` for each field.
Provides indexed access to a stored `NllMemberConstraint` by forwarding to the internal constraints array. It does not call other methods from this file.

Walks to the tail of one linked list of member constraints and splices another list onto it by updating the final `next_constraint` pointer. This is used by `into_mapped` when several old keys collapse to the same new key.
method_docs.compiler/rustc_ast_lowering/src/lib.rs::: Formats an `ImplTraitPosition` as a user-facing descriptive string by matching the enum variant and writing the chosen text with `write!`.

Builds an index from local def-ids to their owning AST nodes for the crate and nested items. It creates the `Indexer` with `IndexVec::new`, seeds the crate entry via `ensure_contains_elem`, then traverses the AST by calling `visit::walk_crate`, which dispatches into the visitor methods `visit_item`, `visit_assoc_item`, and `visit_foreign_item` while skipping attribute lowering through `visit_attribute`.
Intentionally ignores attributes so expressions inside attributes are not indexed or lowered; it does not call other methods in this file.
Registers an AST item as the owner for its def-id in the index by calling `ensure_contains_elem`, then continues recursive traversal by calling `visit::walk_item`.
Registers an associated item as the owner for its def-id in the index by calling `ensure_contains_elem`, then continues recursive traversal by calling `visit::walk_assoc_item`.
Registers a foreign item as the owner for its def-id in the index by calling `ensure_contains_elem`, then continues recursive traversal by calling `visit::walk_item`.

Computes a stable crate HIR fingerprint by collecting owner entries, pairing each with its `def_path_hash` via `tcx.hir().def_path_hash`, sorting them with `sort_unstable_by_key`, and hashing the result inside `tcx.with_stable_hashing_context` using `StableHasher::new`, `hash_stable`, and `finish`.

Temporarily switches lowering state to a new HIR owner, runs the supplied lowering closure, packages the produced owner data, and restores the previous context. It calls `local_def_id` to resolve the owner, uses `std::mem::take`/`replace` to swap state, inserts the owner's zero local id with `insert`, invokes the closure `f(self)`, calls `make_owner_info` to build the final owner info, and finally records the owner in `children`.

Finalizes the accumulated data for one HIR owner into arena-allocated `OwnerInfo`. It takes the pending attrs, bodies, trait map, and inline-const flag, sorts bodies, builds a `SortedMap` with `from_presorted_elements`, calls `self.tcx.hash_owner_nodes(...)` to compute owner and attribute hashes, calls `index::index_hir` to build node and parenting indices, and allocates the resulting `hir::OwnerInfo` with `self.arena.alloc(...)`.

Maps an AST `NodeId` to a HIR id for the current owner, reusing an existing mapping or allocating a new local id. On a vacant entry it inserts the new local id, advances the counter with `increment_by`, calls `opt_local_def_id` to record nested def ownership in `children`, and transfers any pending trait candidates from `resolver.trait_map.remove(...)` into the local `trait_map`.
Allocates the next fresh `HirId` for the current owner by reading the current counter, incrementing it with `increment_by`, and returning the resulting owner/local-id pair.

Converts a resolver `Res<NodeId>` into a HIR `Res` by calling `apply_id` to rewrite each referenced node id through the current `node_id_to_local_id` mapping, using `get` and `copied` for lookup. If rewriting fails for an enclosing-owner local, it returns `Res::Err` via `unwrap_or`.
Obtains the full resolver result for a node id by calling `self.resolver.get_partial_res(id)` and converting it with `map_or(..., |pr| pr.expect_full_res())`, defaulting to `Res::Err` if missing.
Extracts the fully resolved imported items for a `use` item from the resolver. It calls `impl ResolverAstLoweringExt for ResolverAstLowering::get_import_res`.
Returns the session diagnostic handler used by lowering for error reporting. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.
Marks a span as desugared with the given reason and optional unstable allowances using the stable hashing context and current edition. It calls `with_stable_hashing_context` and `mark_with_reason`.
Adjusts a span for HIR lowering, attaching the current owner as the parent only when incremental compilation is enabled; otherwise returns the span unchanged.
Rebuilds an identifier with its span lowered for HIR. This method explicitly calls `lower_span`.

Converts a resolved lifetime into a HIR lifetime generic parameter, creating a new lifetime definition for fresh elided lifetimes and skipping `static`/error cases. It calls `create_def`, `lower_node_id`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.
Temporarily overrides the `is_in_dyn_type` flag while executing a closure, then restores the previous state.
Executes a closure in a fresh lowering scope by temporarily replacing current item, loop-condition, catch, and loop scope state, then restoring all previous values afterward.
Lowers and stores attributes for a HIR node, returning `None` for an empty attribute list. This method explicitly calls `lower_attr` for each attribute.
Lowers a single AST attribute by preserving its path/data structure, stripping tokens, lowering its arguments, and lowering its span. It calls `lower_attr_args` and `lower_span`.
Aliases already-lowered attributes from one HIR local id to another within the same owner when the target has stored attributes.

Lowers an associated type constraint, including its generic arguments, equality/const/type terms, and bound forms, while diagnosing invalid parenthesized or return-type-notation syntax. This method explicitly calls `lower_angle_bracketed_parameter_data`, `emit_bad_parenthesized_trait_in_assoc_ty`, `dcx`, `lower_ty`, `lower_anon_const`, `lower_param_bounds`, `lower_node_id`, and `lower_ident`.

Lowers a generic argument as a lifetime, type, inferred arg, or const arg, including the path-type-to-const disambiguation path used for trivial const arguments. It calls `lower_lifetime`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_span`, `get_partial_res`, `next_node_id`, `create_def`, `with_new_scopes`, `lower_const_body`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_anon_const`.
Lowers an AST type and arena-allocates the resulting HIR type node. This method explicitly calls `lower_ty_direct`.

Lowers a path type, opportunistically converting a bare resolved trait path into a trait object when needed for fresh anonymous lifetimes; otherwise lowers it as a normal qpath type. It calls `get_partial_res`, `with_dyn_type_scope`, `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `elided_dyn_bound`, `lower_span`, `next_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_qpath`, and `ty_path`.
Constructs a HIR type node with a fresh `HirId` and lowered span. It calls `next_id` and `lower_span`.
Constructs a tuple HIR type from pre-lowered element types. This method explicitly calls `ty`.

Performs the main AST-to-HIR lowering for type syntax, handling anonymous ADTs, pointers/references, functions, tuples, paths, and other type forms while creating nested owners when required. This method explicitly calls `local_def_id`, `with_hir_id_owner`, `lower_field_def`, `lower_span`, `lower_ty`, `lower_mt`, `get_lifetime_res`, `next_node_id`, `lower_lifetime`, `lower_lifetime_binder`, `lower_safety`, `lower_extern`, `lower_fn_decl`, and `lower_fn_params_to_names`.

Lowers an `impl Trait` opaque type by marking its desugared span, determining which lifetimes must be captured or duplicated based on origin and precise captures, and delegating final opaque construction. It calls `mark_span_with_reason`, `take_extra_lifetime_params`, `lower_opaque_inner`, and `lower_param_bounds`.

Extracts lowered parameter names from a function declaration, using the lowered identifier for simple identifier patterns and an empty placeholder ident otherwise. It calls `lower_ident` and `lower_span`.

Lowers a function signature by dropping the AST varargs sentinel, lowering each input type under the appropriate `impl Trait` policy, and lowering the return type either normally or through coroutine-specific opaque-return handling. It calls `lower_ty_direct`, `local_def_id`, `lower_coroutine_fn_ret_ty`, `lower_ty`, and `lower_span`.

Lowers an `async fn` return type into the desugared opaque `impl Future` HIR return, collecting captured extra lifetimes, building the async opaque type, and wrapping it as `FnRetTy::Return`. It calls `impl ResolverAstLoweringExt for ResolverAstLowering::take_extra_lifetime_params` and `impl<'a, 'hir> LoweringContext<'a, 'hir>::lower_async_fn_output_type_to_future_bound`.

Builds the `Future<Output = T>` bound used in async-fn desugaring by lowering the explicit return type or synthesizing `()` for default returns, then packaging it as a `Future` lang-item trait bound. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.

Lowers a single generic bound into HIR, converting trait bounds and outlives bounds through the appropriate lowerers. It calls `lower_poly_trait_ref`, `lower_trait_bound_modifiers`, and `lower_lifetime`.
Lowers an AST lifetime by first calling `lower_ident` on the lifetime name, then calling `new_named_lifetime` with the original node id to build the HIR lifetime.

Constructs and arena-allocates a HIR lifetime from an explicit `LifetimeRes`, remapping parameter def-ids when needed via `get_remapped_def_id` or `local_def_id`, and filling the HIR node with `lower_node_id` and `lower_ident`.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic parameter by mapping the input slice and calling `lower_generic_param` for every element.
Lowers a slice of generic parameters into arena-allocated HIR output by calling `lower_generic_params_mut` and collecting the iterator with `alloc_from_iter`.

Lowers one generic parameter by calling `lower_generic_param_kind` to compute its HIR name and kind, then assigns ids/spans/attributes using `lower_node_id`, `lower_attrs`, `local_def_id`, and `lower_span`.
Lowers an AST trait reference by calling `lower_qpath`, requiring the result to be a resolved trait path, and then creating the HIR trait ref with `lower_node_id` for the reference id.
Lowers a poly trait reference by calling `lower_lifetime_binder` for bound generic params, `lower_trait_ref` for the trait itself, and `lower_span` for the resulting HIR span.
Lowers a mutable type by calling `lower_ty` on the inner type and preserving the mutability flag.
Lowers a slice of generic bounds into arena-allocated HIR bounds by calling `lower_param_bounds_mut` and collecting with `alloc_from_iter`.
Returns an iterator that lowers each generic bound by mapping the slice and calling `lower_param_bound` on each element.
Lowers an AST block expression by calling `lower_block` and then wrapping the result with `expr_block`.

Lowers an array length const expression. For `_`, it may create an inferred length using `lower_node_id` and `lower_span` when the feature is enabled; otherwise it reports instability and falls back to calling `lower_anon_const`. All non-underscore lengths are lowered by calling `lower_anon_const`.

Lowers an anonymous const inside fresh scopes by calling `with_new_scopes`; within that closure it uses `local_def_id`, `lower_node_id`, `lower_const_body`, and `lower_span`, then arena-allocates the resulting HIR anon const.
Maps the AST `UnsafeSource` enum directly to the corresponding HIR `UnsafeSource` variant without calling other methods from the list.

Converts an AST trait-bound modifier into its HIR form, gating negative bounds on the corresponding feature flag and choosing placeholder HIR variants for invalid parsed combinations so lowering can continue. It does not call other methods in the Methods List.
Builds a HIR statement by assigning a fresh id with `next_id` and lowering the statement span with `lower_span`.
Builds an expression statement by arena-allocating the expression and then calling `stmt` with `hir::StmtKind::Expr`.

Builds a `let` statement from a pre-lowered pattern and optional initializer. It assigns a fresh id with `next_id`, lowers the span with `lower_span`, stores statement attributes when present, and finally calls `stmt` after arena-allocating the `hir::LetStmt`.
Wraps a lowered expression in a block by calling `block_all` with no statements and the expression as the tail expression.
Constructs and arena-allocates a HIR block from statements and an optional tail expression, assigning a fresh block id with `next_id` and lowering the span with `lower_span`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Continue` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowContinue`.
Builds a `ControlFlow::Break` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the payload and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::ControlFlowBreak`.
Builds an `Option::Some` pattern by first calling `single_pat_field` for the contained pattern and then calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionSome`.
Builds an `Option::None` pattern by directly calling `pat_lang_item_variant` with `hir::LangItem::OptionNone` and no fields.
Creates a single tuple-struct-style pattern field for index 0, assigning a fresh field id with `next_id` and lowering the field spans with `lower_span`.
Builds a struct pattern referring to a lang item variant by lowering the span with `lower_span` to form a `QPath::LangItem`, then calling `pat` with `hir::PatKind::Struct`.
Builds an identifier pattern with the default binding mode by calling `pat_ident_binding_mode` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE`.

Convenience wrapper that creates a mutable identifier pattern using no explicit binding mode. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` with `hir::BindingMode::NONE` and returns the resulting pattern and `HirId`.

Builds an identifier pattern with an explicit binding mode, then allocates it in the HIR arena. It calls `pat_ident_binding_mode_mut` to construct the `hir::Pat` and `self.arena.alloc` to return a shared HIR reference together with its `HirId`.

Constructs an owned `hir::Pat` for an identifier binding with the given binding mode. It calls `next_id` to assign a fresh `HirId`, `lower_ident` to lower the identifier, and `lower_span` to lower the source span.

Allocates a general HIR pattern with default binding modes enabled. It calls `next_id` to create the pattern’s `HirId`, `lower_span` to lower the span, and `self.arena.alloc` to store the pattern in the arena.
Constructs an owned HIR pattern like `pat`, but with `default_binding_modes` disabled. It calls `next_id` for a fresh `HirId` and `lower_span` for the lowered span.

Builds a `hir::Ty` from a qualified path, rewriting resolved trait or trait-alias paths into `hir::TyKind::TraitObject`. In that trait-object case it calls `lower_span` to build the `PolyTraitRef`, `next_id` to give the outer `Ty` a new id, and `elided_dyn_bound` to supply the implicit `dyn` lifetime bound; it also calls `lower_span` again for the final type span.
